top_signals.title: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran Resigns Ahead of AGM Next Week
top_signals.summary: Natarajan Chandrasekaran has stepped down as chairman of Tata Sons Pvt. ahead of a contentious annual shareholder vote, according to a person familiar with the matter, throwing the salt-to-software conglomerate into uncertainty at a time when it’s spearheading the country’s push into high-tech sectors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: SEC, CFTC sue Goliath Ventures over $400M crypto Ponzi scheme
top_signals.summary: Regulators allege Goliath promised crypto liquidity-pool returns but instead paid earlier investors and funded its founder’s luxury spending.
